dataset_metadata.purpose: Deterministic demo and regression fixtures for a California-focused patient/clinician portal.
dataset_metadata.statement: Every record in this dataset is fabricated for software testing. No record represents a real person, provider, clinic, address, phone number, NPI, insurance identifier, or copied clinical note. Nothing here is medical advice or a treatment recommendation.

determinism.note: No value is computed at runtime; fixtures must load identically on every test run.

representation_policy.statement: Preferred language, accessibility needs, work schedule, transportation, caregiving, cost concerns, and communication preferences are stored as individually declared fields. No such attribute was derived from name, sex, age, diagnosis, language, ZIP code, or any ethnicity signal.

before_any_non_demo_use: Every scenario carries clinical_review_required: true. A licensed clinician must review condition, allergy, medication, and timeline content before this dataset is used for anything beyond software demos and regression tests.

No ICD-10, SNOMED, LOINC, RxNorm/RxCUI, NPI, or license values are populated. All such fields are null with requires_validation: true and must be filled by a terminology owner, not inferred by a developer.
No lab values, measurements, reference ranges, or guideline citations appear anywhere. Document records carry metadata only; result_values and reference_ranges are explicitly null.
Dose strings are labelled dose_text_for_display_only. They exist to make timeline rendering realistic and must not be treated as clinical guidance or copied into any production template.
content_boundaries_observed: No treatment recommendations, medical advice, testimonials, or patient stories are present.

Medication changes are recorded as review cues only. Where a patient-reported concern precedes a change, the data states the sequence and nothing more; no causal or diagnostic conclusion is asserted in any field.
Excluded by design: high-acuity emergencies, pregnancy, pediatrics, substance use, psychiatric crisis, and any autonomous treatment-decision flow.
Customer-facing narrative fields use natural portal language; fixture provenance remains in metadata and source IDs.
identifier_and_privacy_checks: No real people, clinics, street addresses, phone numbers, email addresses, NPIs, license numbers, insurance identifiers, or MRNs. Displayed people and organizations use fictional, natural names; source IDs remain internal provenance identifiers.
No race or ethnicity field exists in this dataset.
No clinical note text is copied from any source; all summary strings are original and written for this fixture set.
representation_checks: Preference fields are populated only from a declared source, recorded in declared_preferences.source for every patient.

Coverage spread: age bands 19-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45-54, 55-64, 65-74, 75-84, 85+; genders include women, men, and a nonbinary patient; clinics split 4/4; locales split 5 en-US / 3 es-MX; contact channels cover SMS, email, portal message, voice call, and printed mail.

Accessibility coverage includes screen reader use, low vision, hearing loss with interpreter and captioning requests, large print, and reduced motion — each attached to a patient whose other attributes do not stereotypically pair with it.
Language preference is set independently of every other field. Spanish-preferring patients appear across both clinics, multiple age bands, and different accessibility profiles.
localization_notes: Only en-US and es-MX are used. Spanish strings are written in plain, natural Mexican Spanish and avoid literal calques from English.
Spanish text in this fixture set requires review by a professional es-MX translator before it appears in any customer-facing demo; mark this item open until that review is signed off.
Document records carry an explicit language attribute so the portal can be tested for correct locale selection independent of the patient's UI language setting.
determinism_and_timezone_notes: All timestamps are fixed literals in America/Los_Angeles with explicit UTC offsets: -08:00 during Pacific Standard Time and -07:00 during Pacific Daylight Time. Offsets were checked against 2025 and 2026 transition dates.
Only appointment rows are dated after 2026-08-22; all other events are in the past relative to that date, so 'upcoming appointment' assertions remain stable without any runtime date arithmetic.

Medication records that share a substance or a substitution use a single shared boundary date, with the prior record's end_date equal to the successor's start_date. No discontinued record ever returns to active status, and no two records for the same substance overlap.
SYN-PT-006 declares quiet hours that cross midnight (01:00-09:00), which should be used to test range logic that wraps past 00:00.
